rows.speaker: Benkei
rows.en: Radar contact! It's the Hyakki Empire!
rows.display_text: 「Radar contact! It's the Hyakki Empire!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: Bring it on! We're not running or hiding!
rows.display_text: 「Bring it on! We're not running or hiding!」

rows.speaker: Hayato
rows.en: Looks like this is their advance guard.
rows.display_text: 「Looks like this is their advance guard.」

rows.speaker: Michiru
rows.en: According to Father's calculations, Emperor Burai's Science Fortress Island will appear at that point in four minutes.
rows.display_text:
「By Father's calculations, Emperor Burai's
Science Fortress Island will appear there
in four minutes.」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: So the fight is decided in four minutes...!
rows.display_text:
「So the fight is decided in four
minutes...!」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Let's scatter these guys before then!
rows.display_text: 「Let's scatter these guys before then!」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: We only get one chance to strike the Science Fortress Island.
rows.display_text:
「We only get one chance to strike the
Science Fortress Island.」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: In four minutes, break through their fighter squadron and head for the point where Emperor Burai will appear!
rows.display_text:
「In four minutes, break their fighters
and reach Emperor Burai's appearance
point!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: And then, we put everything into a single strike...!
rows.display_text:
「And then, we put everything into a
single strike...!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: Here we come, Hyakki Empire! We'll show you our strength!
rows.display_text:
「Here we come, Hyakki Empire! We'll show
you our strength!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: You came, Emperor Burai!
rows.display_text: 「You came, Emperor Burai!」

rows.speaker: Burai
rows.en: Getter Robo, and your companions -- your futile resistance ends here.
rows.display_text:
「Getter Robo, and your companions --
your futile resistance ends here.」

rows.speaker: Burai
rows.en: I myself shall crush you, mankind's so-called hope, with my own two hands.
rows.display_text:
「I myself shall crush you, mankind's
so-called hope, with these two hands.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Like hell we will! As long as we're around, your ambitions end here!
rows.display_text:
「Like hell we will! As long as we're
around, your ambitions end here!」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: Don't think we were sitting around waiting for you with no preparation at all!
rows.display_text:
「Don't think we sat waiting for you with
no preparation at all!」

rows.speaker: Burai
rows.en: Bark all you like from a distance! Before the Science Fortress Island's defense system, you're nothing but gnats!
rows.display_text:
「Bark all you like from afar! Before the
Science Fortress Island's defenses, you're
nothing but gnats!」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: Don't underestimate us... don't underestimate the power of humanity, Emperor Burai!
rows.display_text:
「Don't underestimate us, or humanity's
power, Emperor Burai!」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: Everyone ready!? We're putting all our strength into one strike!
rows.display_text:
「Everyone ready!? We're putting all our
strength into one strike!」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: We've only got one chance! We'll settle this in a single shot!
rows.display_text:
「We've only got one chance! We'll settle
this in a single shot!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: This is it, Hyakki Empire! Take our strike of fury!!
rows.display_text:
「This is it, Hyakki Empire! Take our
strike of fury!!」

rows.speaker: Burai
rows.en: R-ridiculous! The Science Fortress Island, wrecked in a single hit!?
rows.display_text:
「R-ridiculous! The Science Fortress
Island, wrecked in a single hit!?」

rows.speaker: Burai
rows.en: Grr, fall back! Remember this, Getter Robo!
rows.display_text:
「Grr, fall back! Remember this, Getter
Robo!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: We did it, everyone! We won!
rows.display_text: 「We did it, everyone! We won!」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: The damage we dealt was {tm}, huh. Not bad at all.
rows.display_text:
「The damage we dealt was {tm}, huh.
Not bad at all.」

rows.speaker: Hayato
rows.en: By my calculations, the max damage we could deal exceeds 40,000.
rows.display_text:
「By my calculations, the max damage we
could deal exceeds 40,000.」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: We got pretty close to that. We can be proud of it.
rows.display_text:
「We got pretty close to that. We can be
proud of it.」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: This is the result of all of us combining our strength... a victory we won together.
rows.display_text:
「What all our combined strength
achieved... a victory we won together.」

rows.speaker: Benkei
rows.en: Still, the Hyakki Empire isn't destroyed. Those guys... they'll come again.
rows.display_text:
「Still, the Hyakki Empire isn't destroyed.
They'll be back.」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: No matter how many times they come, as long as we're here, we won't let them have their way.
rows.display_text:
「However many times they come, as long
as we're here, they won't get their way.」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: Striking down evil for the sake of peace. That's our mission, after all.
rows.display_text:
「Striking down evil for peace's sake.
That's our mission, after all.」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: You're being naive, Koji. You can't be satisfied with just this much.
rows.display_text:
「You're naive, Koji. Don't be satisfied
with just this much.」

rows.speaker: Hayato
rows.en: By my calculations, the max damage we could deal exceeds 40,000, after all.
rows.display_text:
「By my calculations, our max damage
exceeds 40,000, after all.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Heh... guess there's always a bigger fish, huh.
rows.display_text:
「Heh... guess there's always a bigger
fish, huh.」

rows.speaker: Duke
rows.en: But Emperor Burai did retreat. This is the result of all of us combining our strength... a victory we won together.
rows.display_text:
「But Emperor Burai retreated -- the
result of all our combined strength... a
victory we won together.」

rows.speaker: Burai
rows.en: Nuoooh! Show them a bit of mercy and they get carried away!
rows.display_text:
「Nuoooh! Show them a bit of mercy and
they get carried away!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: Damage {tm}! No good, this won't stop the fortress!
rows.display_text:
「Damage {tm}! No good, this won't
stop the fortress!」

rows.speaker: Burai
rows.en: I'll show no more mercy! With my full power and that of the Science Fortress Island, I'll snuff out your very last breath!
rows.display_text:
「No more mercy! With my power and the
Science Fortress Island's, I'll snuff out
your last breath!」

rows.speaker: Hayato
rows.en: Tch! Did our half-hearted attack just light Burai's fuse!?
rows.display_text:
「Tch! Did our half-hearted attack just
light Burai's fuse!?」

rows.speaker: Benkei
rows.en: N-no good! The power gap is just too overwhelming!
rows.display_text:
「N-no good! The power gap is just too
overwhelming!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: Damn it! The operation's a failure!!
rows.display_text: 「Damn it! The operation's a failure!!」

rows.speaker: Burai
rows.en: The games end here! I'll show you the true power of this Science Fortress Island!
rows.display_text:
「Games end here! I'll show you this
Science Fortress Island's true power!」

rows.speaker: Benkei
rows.en: N-no good! We're being overwhelmed by their defense system!
rows.display_text:
「N-no good! We're being overwhelmed by
their defense system!」

rows.speaker: Hayato
rows.en: Tch! At this rate, forget attacking -- we can't even run!
rows.display_text:
「Tch! At this rate, forget attacking --
we can't even run!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: Damn it! The operation's a failure!
rows.display_text: 「Damn it! The operation's a failure!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: The Hyakki Empire's Science Fortress Island is headed this way!?
rows.display_text:
「The Hyakki Empire's Science Fortress
Island is headed this way!?」

rows.speaker: Hayato
rows.en: The institute's radar picked up its movement. It'll likely make landfall in Japan in two hours.
rows.display_text:
「The institute's radar caught its
movement. It'll likely reach Japan in two
hours.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: If that's how they want it, we'll just turn the tables on them! Let's go, everyone!
rows.display_text:
「If that's how they want it, we'll turn
the tables on them! Let's go, everyone!」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: But the enemy's a giant aerial fortress. If we just charge in recklessly, we won't stand a chance.
rows.display_text:
「The enemy's a giant aerial fortress.
Charging in recklessly won't give us a
chance.」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: Tetsuya's right. Against that fortress's defense system, even getting close will be difficult.
rows.display_text:
「Tetsuya's right. Against that fortress's
defenses, even getting close will be
tough.」

rows.speaker: Boss
rows.en: Damn it! What are we supposed to do!? We're out of time!
rows.display_text:
「Damn it! What are we supposed to do!?
We're out of time!」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: ...One decisive blow.
rows.display_text: 「...One decisive blow.」

rows.speaker: Benkei
rows.en: Ryo...

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: It's precisely because their defenses are so strong that carelessness creeps in. We just have to strike that opening...!
rows.display_text:
「Strong defenses breed carelessness. We
just have to strike that opening...!」

rows.speaker: Hayato
rows.en: We've only got one chance. If we don't deal decisive damage there, it'll turn into a war of attrition.
rows.display_text:
「One shot is all we get. Miss decisive
damage, and it becomes a war of
attrition.」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: And if that happens, our defeat is certain.
rows.display_text:
「And if that happens, our defeat is
certain.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Then we put everything into that one strike! Let's do this, everyone!
rows.display_text:
「Then we put everything into that one
strike! Let's do this, everyone!」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: All right...! Let's adjust every unit to deal the highest possible damage in a single strike.
rows.display_text:
「All right...! Let's set every unit to
deal max damage in a single strike.」

rows.speaker: Ryouma
rows.en: Bring it on, Emperor Burai...! We'll show you the true power of a cornered human being!
rows.display_text:
「Bring it on, Emperor Burai...! We'll show
a cornered human's true power!」
